root_cause: ComputeNodeClient inherits HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY because httpx proxy=None does not disable trust_env. QEWorkspaceClient already uses trust_env=False; health observer and execution client therefore take different routes.
